title: Carrow Coast Community Fund — Autumn 2019 grants round
text: Among this autumn's awards is a grant of £4,000 to the Fernhaven Seed Library, which has lent vegetable and flower seed free of charge to local growers since it was founded in 2014. The award will pay for new shelving and a seed-drying cabinet at the library's home in the former lifeboat station on Quay Street. Trustees noted the library's strong record of returning value to the town on a small budget.
notes: Grant-maker newsletter register. Third independent statement of the 2014 founding, plus location, purpose, and the grant that the annual report's funding line corroborates.
